topic_zh: Rust 知识全景：五块知识怎么搭
topic_en: The big picture of Rust in 5 blocks

xhs.title: 学 Rust 不知道从哪开始？先看这张图
xhs.body:
Rust 其实就五块知识，一层一层往上搭：
基础语法 → 所有权 → 数据建模 → 工程化 → 进阶
最难也最重要的是所有权，基础可以快速过。
你现在卡在哪一层？评论区告诉我～

douyin.title: 一分钟看懂 Rust 学习路线
douyin.body: 五块知识，一层层往上搭，重点吃透所有权。

tiktok.body: Learning Rust? It's really just 5 blocks. Master ownership, move fast on the rest.

linkedin.title: Rust looks huge. It's really five blocks.
linkedin.body:
Basics → ownership → data modeling → engineering → advanced.
Ownership is the hardest and the most important; the basics go fast if you know Python.
Which block are you on right now?
